accountability and institutional constraints matter more than leadership strength.", "4": "Public funding enables basic research and public goods that markets systematically underinvest in, making it essential alongside private R&D.", "5": "Cultures differ in their promotion of human flourishing, rights, and dignity; some cultural practices are objectively more conducive to well-being than others.", "6": "Both corporate and government oppression are serious threats; governments wield monopoly force while corporations exercise massive unelected power over daily life and democracy.", "7": "Worker ownership models like cooperatives democratize workplaces effectively, though strong labor rights and social ownership in mixed economies also achieve fairness.", "8": "Inheritance perpetuates intergenerational inequality; heavy taxation of large estates is fair while allowing modest personal bequests.", "9": "Regional unions promote peace, cooperation, and collective problem-solving on shared challenges, though they require democratic accountability.", "10": "Universal healthcare is a moral imperative and practical necessity; harmful traditions should be discarded rather than preserved.", "13": "Security and liberty are both essential; sacrificing core civil liberties often undermines the values we defend and is rarely necessary with competent intelligence.", "14": "Climate change is an existential threat requiring immediate, massive global action; justice matters more than mere order.", "17": "Natural monopolies like utilities often serve the public better under democratic ownership than profit-driven private control.", "18": "Wars require justification to the international community and one's own citizens;
